name: Lava USA
old_description: LAVA TEXTILES is a Belgian family-owned knitting company since 1925. We combine many years of technical experience with state-of-the-art machinery for knitted fabrics. We are driven towards innovation, excellent quality and service at competitive prices thanks to our production facilities in Belgium (1925), USA (2007), Romania (2011), Indonesia (2018) and our brand new site in Mexico (2021). Creating extraordinary designs that confer real added value to the fabric is part and parcel of the company’s DNA.
about:
Lava USA operates as the American arm of Lava Textiles, a Belgian family-owned knitting company founded in 1925. The business established its first U.S. production facility in 2007 in York, South Carolina, joining existing sites in Belgium, Romania, Indonesia, and a 2021 addition in Mexico. The company remains under family ownership, though the founding family is not named in available materials.

The company specializes in knitted fabrics, combining decades of technical experience with modern machinery across its five global production locations. While specific facility sizes, headcounts, and annual volumes are not disclosed, the operation spans multiple continents and emphasizes design-driven fabric development.

Lava Textiles serves customers seeking knitted fabrics for a range of applications, though the input does not specify particular industries or named clients. The company positions its output as adding real value through extraordinary designs, suggesting a focus on differentiated textile solutions rather than commodity production.

According to the company, its direction is driven by innovation, excellent quality, and service at competitive prices. Creating extraordinary designs that confer real added value to the fabric is described as part of the company's DNA, reflecting a philosophy that blends heritage with ongoing technical investment.
